RESEARCH-SOURCED — GTA VI radio discovery lane (alt-rap / Leonida)
scene_use: Rockstar's GTA VI (launch Nov 19, 2026, modern-day Leonida) continues the series' radio tradition: genre-spanning in-game stations mixing established hits with indie up-and-comers. Public reporting lists a contemporary hip-hop lane among the rumored stations, and Rockstar has used stations hosted/curated by artists with exclusive recordings (GTA V/GTA Online). source_note: Sourced from public reporting (GameSpot radio-station list; beebom confirmed-song list; Jermaine Dupri on artist-upload feature), Sept 2026. Not posted by Rockstar or a Rockstar supervisor; no contact with the music team exists.

title: RESEARCH-SOURCED — NBA 2K27 seasonal soundtrack refresh (emerging rap)
scene_use: NBA 2K27 (launched Sept 4, 2026) refreshes its 57-song launch soundtrack each season; season programming is selected by musicians, producers and 2K's music team. Director of Partnerships & Licensing David Kelley has said the team scours SoundCloud/Bandcamp for emerging artists (NME interview, Sept 2026), and a 2K spot can multiply an artist's Spotify listeners several-fold. Seeking confident, high-energy rap with anthemic swagger for the seasonal menu/playlist rotation.
source_note: Sourced from public reporting (NME David Kelley interview; NME launch-soundtrack list), Sept 2026. Not posted by 2K or David Kelley; no direct channel verified.

title: RESEARCH-SOURCED — EA Sports FC Mobile community-track window (Oct 2026)
